title: ESPN's Troy Aikman says he'll be a 'free agent' after season, laughs about reported tension with Joe Buck

sources.name: Yahoo Sports NFL
sources.title: ESPN's Troy Aikman says he'll be a 'free agent' after season, laughs about reported tension with Joe Buck
sources.description: 'Monday Night Football' announcer Troy Aikman indicated on Thursday that this season could be his last at ESPN. He laughed at the mention of reported tension with longtime broadcast partner Joe Buck.
